lines.text: Remember Gerald? Nobody stopped him before Christmas.
lines.caption: Remember Gerald? Nobody stopped him before Christmas.

lines.text: So now he owns three hundred boxes, and has no idea what's inside.
lines.caption: So now he owns three hundred boxes, and has no idea what's inside.

lines.text: Gerald did the only thing he could. He wrapped them all.
lines.caption: Gerald did the only thing he could. He wrapped them all.

lines.text: Then he heard about Christmas dinner. Gerald is a turkey.
lines.caption: Then he heard about Christmas dinner. Gerald is a turkey.

lines.text: So he stacked every present into a giant Christmas tree,
lines.caption: So he stacked every present into a giant Christmas tree,

lines.text: and hid on top, pretending to be the star.
lines.caption: and hid on top, pretending to be the star.

lines.text: Nobody noticed. Merry Christmas, Gerald. See you at New Year's.
lines.caption: Nobody noticed. Merry Christmas, Gerald. See you at New Year's.
